content: A gentle radiance follows you, pushing back the darkness.
In near-total darkness (light level 2 or below), a soft light blooms beneath your feet, held there by instinct rather than will. It fades on its own when you move on — a fleeting warmth, not a torch.
After attuning to the Light element, the lights placed by Soft Glow are both brighter and last longer.
They also start to appear earlier (light level 4 or below)
